blocks.text: Tropical Champions Parade 2027: Rio de Janeiro and Búzios

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The approved Word 2027 title is Tropical Champions Parade, but the complete catalogue title adds the year and two destinations.

blocks.text: 10 days, 12–21 February 2027: three nights in Rio de Janeiro with the Parade of Champions at the Sambadrome, Sugar Loaf and Corcovado, followed by six nights beside the ocean in Búzios. Carnival tickets, guided tours with an English-speaking guide, scheduled transfers and breakfast are included.
